summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement for a public offering of $350 million in 5.200% senior notes due 2036 by W. P. Carey Inc. The notes are priced at 99.015% of par, with proceeds of approximately $344.3 million net of underwriting discount. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event-driven event is disclosed. It is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
